380 commits. ~15 user-visible. Rest = 150ish dep bumps, ~50 refactors, ~90 test/ci/chore.

## What actually changed

**One feature.** `feat(webhooks): retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff` (395fb48, PR #4191). Touches `src/core/config.js` — likely new config knobs. Get names from Ana Ruiz before shipping notes.

**Three things that break callers, all mislabeled:**
- `refactor(api): drop the unused v1 export route` (56dc828, PR #4152). Labeled refactor, but touches `router.js` + `handlers.js` + tests. Route removal. Confirm "unused" means no external traffic.
- `refactor(*): stop re-exporting the internal error types` — 8 commits, scopes core/db/jobs/auth/billing/store. Import surface shrank. Anyone catching those types breaks on upgrade.
- `fix(auth): return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` (1d2bd55, PR #4223). Status code change. Clients branching on 403 break.

**Node version — verify.** 5 `docs: note the minimum node version` commits, CI moved to node 22, `.nvmrc` pinned. Docs and CI are not binding. Check whether `package.json` `engines` actually changed. If yes it's Breaking; if no, drop it.

**Real fixes** (deduped — same subject repeats across scopes):

| Effect | Commits |
|---|---|
| timer not cleared when socket drops | f66d359 |
| connection pool not closed on shutdown | eb874a5 |
| paginator crashed on null cursor | api/queue/webhooks/db ×4 |
| empty allowlist rejected everything | store/db/jobs ×3 |
| trailing slash trimmed twice | queue/jobs ×2 |
| duplicate header sent | http/core/billing ×5 |
| trace id lost across retry | api ×3 |
| whole request body written to logs | 1b55313 — privacy, call out |
| latency histogram used wrong units | core/store ×2 |
| token parser error message vague | core/billing/queue ×3 |

**Perf, 12 commits** (batch metric writes, skip JSON round-trip, drop mapper clone, reuse parsed schema). No heading for these in your format. Recommend omit — none change behavior.

**Deps: omit all.** Runtime bumps (pg, pino, knex, ioredis, fastify, undici, zod, nanoid, dotenv) all patch/minor. Rest dev-only.

## Draft

```markdown
## 4.2.0 — 2026-08-28

### Breaking
- Expired tokens now return 401 instead of 403. Clients that branch on 403
  need updating.
- The internal error types are no longer re-exported from the package root.
  Import them from their own modules, or match on the error code instead.
- The v1 export route has been removed. Use the v2 route.

### Added
- Failed webhook deliveries are retried with exponential backoff.

### Fixed
- The HTTP client no longer leaks a timer when the socket drops, and it closes
  its connection pool on shutdown.
- Paginating past the last page no longer throws on a null cursor.
- An empty allowlist no longer rejects every request.
- Requests no longer go out with a duplicate header.
- The trace id survives a retry.
- Request bodies are no longer written to the logs.
- The latency histogram reports the right units.
```

Blockers before you publish: the webhook config option names, whether `engines` moved, and whether that v1 route had live callers. Want me to write this into CHANGELOG.md?
